scenario: Five sequential TrueConf meetings using signed Mac app build 112, receiving a synthetic publisher from a separate process. One prior warm-up.
uiObservations: A generated color pattern appeared in each run.
Two participant labels were explicitly confirmed in runs 3, 4, and 5.
Run 5 initially displayed the meeting view while still connecting; it later showed two participants and the test pattern.
All five 10-second sample windows were collected after the test pattern was observed.
A scripted transition after run 1 reached Home later than expected; run 2 was then started once Home was confirmed.
limitations: One device and one room; background system load was not measured.
Mic and camera were off; no physical input, outgoing track or audio audibility was verified.
Video-pattern appearance was visually checked; exact first-frame time, frame cadence, and all five independent frame movements were not measured.
The meeting view appears during connection and its appearance time must not be treated as join latency.
One publisher process stayed connected throughout the series; app sessions were sequential, not independent publisher runs.
The user-provided room was added to the app Recents through normal behavior.
